summary: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Bay Street, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting that Council not authorize the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Bay Street and St. Mary Street as the technical justification for the installation of traffic control signals is not satisfied.
decided: City Council on October 2 and 3, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize and request the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services to install traffic control signals at the intersection of Bay Street and St. Mary Street as soon as possible to enhance protections for vulnerable road users, especially pedestrians and cyclists, as part of Vision Zero.

motions.desc: Majority required - TE8.50 - Adopt the item
